title: lichen-node cfg(test) build broken on main: router.rs lookup_route/lookup_route_at/inject_route vs Ipv6Addr RoutingTable API
description: main is broken for all lichen-node test builds (blocks dyqf verification and every worker's lichen-node tests). worker7 sync 6af03283c2 (2026-09-08 18:11 PDT) migrated lichen-rpl RoutingTable to the Ipv6Addr newtype (add_route/lookup take Ipv6Addr, return &[Ipv6Addr]) but did not update lichen-node's router.rs: lookup_route (router.rs:1065-1072), lookup_route_at (:1075-1078), inject_route (:1081-1083) still pass/return [u8;16] arrays -> 3x E0308 under cargo test/check --all-targets. Lib-only check passes because callers are cfg(test) plus one production caller (rpl_stack/mod.rs:246 route_for, whose destination is [u8;16] and RoutePlan.source_route is Vec<[u8;16]>). Fix: migrate lookup_route/lookup_route_at to Ipv6Addr signatures (matching table.rs), convert inject_route internally (caller-less test helper), convert at the mod.rs:246 call site (Ipv6Addr::from(destination) in, octets() back out to preserve RoutePlan's array type), and update cfg(test) call sites in routing/tests.rs and node.rs. Minimal-intrusion: lichen-node's public array types (RoutePlan etc.) unchanged — the wider newtype migration is ow1e.111's scope (owner-reserved).
close_reason: Fixed: lichen-node lib + tests compile again. lookup_route/lookup_route_at migrated to &core::net::Ipv6Addr -> Option<&[Ipv6Addr]> (router.rs:1067-1078, matching lichen-rpl table.rs); inject_route keeps array signature (gateway.rs has 5 callers), converts internally; mod.rs route_for converts at boundary preserving RoutePlan's Vec<[u8;16]>; gateway.rs is_local_mesh + mesh_to_mesh convert at lookup (mesh_to_mesh converts once to owned arrays, downstream SRH/tunnel byte logic untouched); ~60 call sites across node.rs/runtime.rs/routing+rs/tests.rs/rpl_stack+tests.rs/dao_origin_vectors.rs (+route_arrays helper). Main's breakage was lib-level (router.rs helpers are pub, not cfg(test)) — every worker was blocked. Verified: cargo check --workspace --all-targets 0 errors (wio-e5 firmware's panic_halt host-test E0152 is structural/pre-existing, excluded from default-members); lichen-node 358 lib tests + all integration suites green; lichen-gateway 268 lib + suites green (runtime_ingress_dispatches_authenticated_gcp_slot_claim stays RED as documented in ljgs — intentional, pre-existing). 3x codereview (kimi-k3): pass1 found missed gateway sites (fixed, re-review PASS), security PASS, edge-cases PASS; fmt finding addressed in f0d67913bb. Code landed via sync commit e2d50e25e4 + fmt commit f0d67913bb.
